csv_project_name: PM for Vienna New Aquatics & Fitness Facility
csv_scope_of_work: The Town is soliciting proposals from qualified Project Management (PM) firms to provide comprehensive project management services for the planning, design, and construction of a new Aquatic and Fitness Facility. The PM will serve as the Town s representative throughout the project lifecycle, overseeing the design firm and construction contractor to ensure that the project is delivered on time, within budget, and consistent with all program, operational, architectural, and quality requirements. The Town intends to develop a multigenerational Aquatic and Fitness Facility including indoor aquatics, wellness/fitness areas, community program spaces, and supporting infrastructure. The design and construction of this facility requires professional project management support to coordinate stakeholders, ensure compliance with Town processes, guide technical consultants, and maintain control over scope, schedule, budget, and quality. The Town anticipates the following phases: 1. Design-Firm Procurement 2. Conceptual Design 3. Schematic Design (50%) and Early Cost Reconciliation 4. Design Development (100%) and Refined Cost Reconciliation 5. Final Construction Documents (Bid-Ready Plans & Specifications) 6. Construction-Firm Procurement 7. Construction and Closeout
